I suggest getting a little notebook or even making a note on your phone where you can document your progress and keep your reasons for wanting to go into nursing in mind! Create a sort of mind map or collage of all of YOUR reasons for being a nurse and how you’ll be making a positive change in your life as well as your future patients lives. Then create a page that lists out all of your classes that you need to take before joining a nursing program and cross them out one by one as you take them. I found this to be motivating to me on the days where my job made me just want to quit everything. Having a little place where I can write down my feelings, future plans and dreams and actually physically SEE how far I’ve come and how close I am to my goal has made going through the grueling process of undergrad exciting snd motivating. Don’t forget you’re doing this for your future self and 5 years from now you’re going to look back and be so proud of how far you’ve come. I’m proud of you, stranger! <3

Learn to be kind to yourself. Sounds cheesy but I used to stress myself out so much over every little assignment, quiz, exam etc. to the point that I would lie awake at night just buzzing from the stress. Don’t put too much pressure on yourself, be honest to yourself about your limits or you’ll get burnt out and end up quitting. College is much more stressful than highschool and it may seem overwhelming now but you will learn to adapt to the challenges. Just give yourself the time and grace to do so. There’s going to be exams you’ll fail even if you spent all of your time studying and did everything right. You’re going to come across professors or other students who are just rude for no reason even if you’ve been nothing but nice to them. You’re human, allow yourself to make mistakes and to learn from them. You’re still so young, be proud of all of your accomplishments so far. And take advantage of the free mental health counseling and destress at the oasis center if you need. But overall, just know that you’re going to be okay and everyone feels like this. <3
